claim_boundary: This boundary records operational-readiness criteria tied to the bounded operational-maturity criteria map, plus a claim guard for each maturity surface. It does not claim a global acceptance threshold, unified generated-artifact lifecycle inventory, semantic documentation verification, signed release provenance, cross-platform CI policy, or owner review signoff.

operational_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: six section-level criteria with risk classes and acceptance-gate labels
operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: section-level operational criteria and global maturity decision
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: global threshold that defines when operational maturity can be claimed

operational_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: run-artifact lifecycle gaps are documented in separate code and papers TODOs
operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: runtime artifacts, generated paper artifacts, overwrite policy, and schema ownership
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: single lifecycle inventory for manifest, history, best workspace, evaluator artifacts, plugin artifacts, prompt tables, and paper_artifacts

operational_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: structural documentation inventories and bounded claim sidecars
operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: README, ROADMAP, docs, papers index, status, and completed TODO claims
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: semantic verifier that proves operational-maturity claims match implementation evidence

operational_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: release reproducibility boundary and code TODOs without signed provenance
operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: release artifacts, package metadata, source hygiene, and install verification
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: signed release provenance and install-from-wheel/index verification

operational_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: path-scoped CI workflow coverage boundary plus local validation commands
operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: GitHub Actions, local validation, integration tests, paper/docs checks, and branch policy
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: cross-platform CI policy covering code, docs, papers, release, integration, and local-PDF gates

operational_claim_guard.maturity_surface: owner-reviewed operational readiness decision and release/policy exceptions
operational_claim_guard.missing_before_maturity_claim: owner signoff preventing one green release or CI boundary from being mistaken for maturity
